investigation_notes.Scriptblock: Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data' -Destination C:\ProgramData\chrome_cache.db -Force; Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*.default-release\logins.json' -Destination C:\ProgramData\ff_cache.json -Force
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command copied browser credential stores from multiple user profiles (Chrome 'Login Data' and Firefox 'logins.json') to local ProgramData files on HR-SRV-02 under account k.tamm. No initiating process hash or external network indicators were provided and there are no recent related events or similar alerts in the environment. The behavior is consistent with credential harvesting or local aggregation of sensitive data, which presents significant risk of credential exposure and potential lateral movement or exfiltration, so this is classified as High Priority.
